fields.help_en:
The language name. This parameter is valid only for RTMP inputs and specifies the Name tag used by the output.
The value can be up to 32 characters in length and supports the following character types:
Unicode letters of various languages: including Latin letters (such as English and French), Chinese, Arabic, and letters of other languages.
Digits: 0 to 9. 
Underscores (_) 
Hyphens (-)
Spaces: spaces can appear in the middle of the value, but not at the beginning or end
fields.help_zh:
语言名称，仅rtmp类型输入有效，表示output使用的Name标签。
该字段长度限制为英文32字符，支持以下字符类型：
Unicode各国语言的字母：包括拉丁字母（如英语、法语）、中文、阿拉伯字母以及其他语言的字母。
数字：允许使用0-9的数字字符。 
英文下划线 (_) 
英文中划线 (-)
空格，空格可以出现在字段中间，不能出现在首尾

fields.help_en:
The height of the video resolution. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the height is automatically scaled based on the width.
Valid values:
For standard transcoding: max(Width, Height) < 3840 and min(Width, Height) < 2160.
For Narrowband HD transcoding: max(Width, Height) < 1920 and min(Width, Height) < 1080
fields.help_zh:
视频分辨率高，不设置或者设置为0则按Width自适应缩放。

取值范围：
对于普通转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 3840，min(Width, Height) < 2160
对于窄带高清转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 1920，min(Width, Height) < 1080

视频编码类型。
可选值：H264，H265

fields.help_zh: 视频编码级别。暂不支持

视频帧率设置模式。
可选值：SPECIFIED（固定帧率），FROM_SOURCE（帧率随源）
fields.name: framerate_control

fields.help_en: The denominator of the fixed frame rate. This parameter is required when the frame rate setting mode is set to SPECIFIED. Valid values: 1 to 60. The value must be divisible by the numerator
fields.help_zh: 固定帧率的帧率分母，当视频帧率设置模式为SPECIFIED时必传。范围: [1,60]，需要能被分子整除
fields.name: framerate_denominator

fields.help_en: The numerator of the fixed frame rate. This parameter is required when the frame rate setting mode is set to SPECIFIED. Valid values: 1 to 60. The denominator must be divisible by the numerator
fields.help_zh: 固定帧率的帧率分子，当视频帧率设置模式为SPECIFIED时必传。范围: [1,60]，需要能整除分母
fields.name: framerate_numerator

fields.help_en: The video frame rate settings. If you do not specify this parameter, the frame rate settings of the source video are used
fields.help_zh: 视频帧率设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: framerate

fields.help_en: The number of B-frames. Valid values: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: B帧数。范围: [1, 3]
fields.name: bframes_num

fields.help_en: The size of the video GOP. If the length unit is SECONDS, valid values are 1 to 20. If the length unit is FRAMES, valid values are 1 to 3000
fields.help_zh:
视频GOP大小。
当长度单位为SECONDS时，取值范围为[1, 20]。当长度单位为FRAMES时，取值范围为[1, 3000]
fields.name: gop_size

fields.help_en: The unit of the video GOP length. Valid values: FRAMES (frames) and SECONDS (seconds)
fields.help_zh:
视频GOP长度单位。
可选值：FRAMES（单位帧），SECONDS（单位秒）
fields.name: gop_size_units

fields.help_en: The video group of pictures (GOP) settings. If you do not specify this parameter, the GOP settings of the source video are used
fields.help_zh: 视频GOP设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: gop

fields.help_en: The video bitrate. Unit: bit/s. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the bitrate of the source video is used. Valid values: 50000 to 6000000. The value must be a multiple of 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频比特率，单位bps。不填或0则随源。范围:[50000,6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en: The buffer size for video encoding. Unit: bit/s. Valid values: 100000 to 6000000. The value must be a multiple of 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频编码缓冲区大小，单位bps。范围: [100000, 6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: buffer_size

fields.help_en: The maximum bitrate for video encoding. Unit: bit/s. Valid values: 100000 to 6000000. The value must be a multiple of 1000
fields.help_zh: 视频编码最大比特率，单位bps。范围: [100000, 6000000]，需要能被1000整除
fields.name: max_bitrate

fields.help_en: The rate control mode for video encoding. Valid values: CBR, ABR, and VBR
fields.help_zh:
视频编码码控规则。
可选值：CBR、ABR和VBR
fields.name: rate_control_mode

fields.help_en: The video encoding rate settings. If you do not specify this parameter, the rate settings of the source video are used
fields.help_zh: 视频编码速率设置，不设置则随源
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The video codec settings
fields.help_zh: 视频编码设置
fields.name: video_codec_setting

fields.help_en:
The video transcoding method. Valid values:
NORMAL: standard transcoding.
NBHD: Narrowband HD transcoding.
Default value: NORMAL
fields.help_zh:
视频转码方式，枚举。可选值：

NORMAL：普通转码。
NBHD：窄带高清转码。

不配置时默认为普通转码
fields.name: video_codec_type

fields.help_en:
The width of the video resolution. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to 0, the width is automatically scaled based on the height.
Valid values:
For standard transcoding: max(Width, Height) < 3840 and min(Width, Height) < 2160.
For Narrowband HD transcoding: max(Width, Height) < 1920 and min(Width, Height) < 1080
fields.help_zh:
视频分辨率宽，不设置或者设置为0则按Height自适应缩放。

取值范围：
对于普通转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 3840，min(Width, Height) < 2160
对于窄带高清转码，需要满足max(Width, Height) < 1920，min(Width, Height) < 1080
fields.name: width
